goal: Every skill and tool agents use on this Mac is installed, signed in and answers a real call, computer use (Cua) and web search first. The check fixes two things itself: it installs a new cua-driver and starts a stopped Cua daemon. Each target is 0 fails because the owner asked for every tool configured right.

metrics.label: Skill and tool checks that fail
Fails that only the owner can fix

onMiss: Fix every fail until the run is green; never only report it. Read each fail's Fix line and change the cause: an entry in ~/.prime/agent/settings.json, a skill text or link (auto-sns-agent through `node scripts/repo/agent/commit.mjs`), a CLI or pi-pool sign-in in the owner's Aside browser, the websearch kernel install. If the check is wrong, or a tool breaks the same way twice, change scripts/duties/skills-and-tools.ts in sieun-pi with a test so the check heals it, then commit and release. Re-check with `node --import tsx scripts/duties/skills-and-tools.ts --only <id>` in sieun-pi components/user-history until it passes. Only a password, a 2FA prompt, a key or a macOS grant goes to the owner, as one For you item with the exact step. off is not a fail. Never send anything outside.
